WITH max_dt AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp))::date AS max_month_start
  FROM orders o
),
cutoff AS (
  SELECT (max_month_start - INTERVAL '23 months')::date AS period_start
  FROM max_dt
),
category_totals AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, 'Unknown') AS product_category_name_english,
    ABS(SUM(oi.price * COALESCE(oi.quantity, 1))) AS total_sales_24m
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN product_category_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
  CROSS JOIN cutoff c
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= c.period_start
  GROUP BY COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, 'Unknown')
  ORDER BY total_sales_24m DESC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT
  TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp), 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
  COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, 'Unknown') AS product_category_name_english,
  ABS(SUM(oi.price * COALESCE(oi.quantity, 1))) AS monthly_sales
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN product_category_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
JOIN category_totals ct ON COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, 'Unknown') = ct.product_category_name_english
JOIN max_dt md ON true
JOIN cutoff c ON true
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= c.period_start
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 DESC, 3 DESC;
